import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read the MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_diffusivity_trial_3/msd.dat', comments='#')

time_ps = data[:, 0]  # Time in ps
msd_A2 = data[:, 1]   # MSD in A^2

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_A2, 'b-', linewidth=1)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)')
plt.title('Mean Square Displacement vs Time')
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# The MSD shows a clear transition from ballistic to diffusive regime
# Looking at the data, the linear diffusive regime starts around 60-70 ps
# Let's use the region from 100 ps to 500 ps for the linear fit

# Define the linear region for fitting
start_idx = np.where(time_ps >= 100)[0][0]
end_idx = len(time_ps)

time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd_A2[start_idx:end_idx]

# Perform linear regression
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"Linear fit statistics:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Å²")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6e}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation: D = slope / 6
# slope is in Å²/ps
# Need to convert to m²/s

# Conversion factors:
# 1 Å = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Å²/ps = (1e-10)² m² / (1e-12 s) = 1e-20 / 1e-12 m²/s = 1e-8 m²/s

D_A2_per_ps = slope / 6.0
D_m2_per_s = D_A2_per_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_A2_per_ps:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"D = {D_m2_per_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"D = {D_m2_per_s:.2e} m²/s")

# Create a plot showing the fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_A2, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.2f} Å²/ps, R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.axvline(x=time_fit[0], color='g', linestyle=':', label='Fit region start')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)')
plt.title('MSD vs Time with Linear Fit')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_with_fit.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# Save the result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient calculation\n")
    f.write(f"================================\n\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit region: {time_fit[0]:.1f} - {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}\n\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (D = slope/6):\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_A2_per_ps:.6f} Å²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_per_s:.6e} m²/s\n\n")
    f.write(f"Final answer (m²/s): {D_m2_per_s:.2e}\n")

print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_per_s:.2e}")
"}
